items.topic: What should happen with this item?
items.context: This item cannot advance without a description. To unblock: (1) add a description via `swarm-manager backlog update --kind idea --name effort-test --data '{"description":"..."}'` then re-run initialization, or (2) archive/delete it. This is the same blocking question from rounds 6 and 7.

options.label: Define it — add a description and re-initialize
options.rationale: Provide a description, then re-run this skill. With context, the plan and workshop can be meaningfully populated.

options.label: Archive it
options.rationale: Move to archived status. Keeps history, removes from active backlog.

options.label: Delete it
options.rationale: Remove entirely. Appropriate if this was a workflow test.
